set.title: Campaign mode crashes on level entry: ReferenceError: state is not defined
set.body:
## Evidence

Browser smoke test against https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/ (scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py in chata-games.github.io):

```
ReferenceError: state is not defined
    at startLevel (src/heartwood-game.js:459:11)
    at Object.start (src/heartwood-game.js:502:7)
    at startLevel (src/campaign.js:112:16)
```

- **Repro**: any browser → Campaign → tap any level marker (or `?level=…`). 100% of entries.
- **Observed**: `#gameScreen` shows, but the HUD stays at placeholders (mana `100`, `Wave 1 / 8`) and nothing animates — `state = createGameState()` throws before `loop.start()` runs.
- **Root cause**: `state` is never declared in the `initHeartwoodGame` closure. ES modules are strict mode, so the bare assignment `state = createGameState()` throws instead of creating a global. Present on `origin/main` (deployed); `src/heartwood-game.js` last touched 2026-07-14 (8b4da3c).
- **Not affected**: `?mode=legacy` (uses `this.state` / instance state) and the newer Phaser `app/` build — which is what the existing Playwright e2e covers, which is why this shipped undetected.
- **Suggested fix**: declare `let state = null;` next to `let fireState` in the closure (`src/heartwood-game.js:75`), re-run `npm run test:e2e`-style browser check against the root game.
- **Regression test**: `python3 scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py` (repo: chata-games.github.io) — currently red on this exact bug; goes green when fixed.

set.title: Direct-level URL (?level=) leaves start screen overlay up, blocking all input
set.body:
## Evidence

Found while verifying RP-bfjtvp with scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py (flow 4, `?level=` direct entry):

- `index.html` ships `#startScreen` without the `hidden` class and with `z-index: 20` (full-viewport overlay).
- `campaign.js start()` only unhides/hides screens when there is **no** `?level` param; with the param it leaves the start screen up while the level auto-starts underneath.
- Result: on `?level=<id>` the player sees the start screen; the battle runs invisibly and every trusted tap hits the overlay (verified via `document.elementFromPoint` → the start screen `H1`), so nothing is playable.
- `hideAllScreens()` in `src/main.js` exists but is dead code — never called.

**Fix**: call `hideAllScreens()` in `main()` before starting the campaign/legacy shell; `campaign.start()` re-shows the start screen in the no-param path, and `?level=` gets a clean battlefield.

text: Fixed in forest-rescue 9f47de9 (declared closure battle state). Deployed to Pages and verified: scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py passes all four flows against https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/ (clean load, map entry, planting, full battle resolution on 00-hand-test-s-curve).

set.title: npm run serve is broken: CommonJS serve.js in a type:module package
set.body:
`npm run serve` (the README's documented dev entry) crashes on main: `serve.js` uses CommonJS `require`, but `package.json` sets `"type": "module"`, so Node refuses:

```
ReferenceError: require is not defined in ES module scope ... use import instead
```

Convert `serve.js` to ESM imports (or rename to `.cjs` and point the script at it).

reason: declared closure state; live Pages smoke passes end to end

set.title: level6-fire simulation test fails on main (0% upgrade win rate)
set.body:
`node --test tests/simulation/level6-fire.test.mjs` fails on clean `origin/main` (no local changes):

```
✖ level 6 fire spread punishes cheap builds but upgrade-first can clear
  AssertionError: fire tools too weak: 0% upgrade win rate
```

Pre-existing — reproduces with `git stash` on 7ab9522 (origin/main). Unrelated to the RP-bfjtvp fix (one declaration line); needs a balance pass or updated simulation expectations.

reason: hideAllScreens() on ?level= entry; verified live via flow 4 of the Pages smoke

text: Fixed in forest-rescue commit fbbb13d (pushed to main, Pages deploy run 33409901233 completed). serve.js converted from CommonJS require/__dirname to ESM imports + import.meta.dirname (package.json sets type:module). Verified: node serve.js boots and serves 200s; local e2e smoke (FR_E2E_SITE=http://localhost:8341/, served BY the fixed serve.js) exit 0; production smoke vs https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/ exit 0 (all 4 flows pass). vitest 301/301 pass; note: pre-existing failure in tests/simulation/level6-fire.test.mjs (node --test) repros on clean main, unrelated to this ticket.

reason: serve.js converted to ESM; npm run serve works; local + production smoke both exit 0 (commit fbbb13d)

text: Root cause was the sim bot, not the level: the upgrade-first bot's cleansing-rain heuristic demanded >=2 burning rings before casting, so it hoarded mana while fire chipped defenders and blocked replanting, losing 100% of level 6 runs. The real game lets players cast rain any time (no such gate in heartwood-game.js), so the bot under-modeled competent play. Fix forest-rescue 165d49b: cast on the first burning ring -> level6-fire sim now 20/20 upgrade-first wins (60/60 on extended seeds, ~3 hearts margin) with cheapest-dps at 0/20, matching the test's design intent. Verified locally: node --test tests/simulation/*.test.mjs 21/21 pass, npx vitest run 301/301 pass. Pages deploy of 165d49b succeeded and production smoke (scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py vs https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/) PASSED end to end. Note: spell data declares cleansing-rain douseImmunity 8 but douseArea is called with the default 5 in both game and sim (dead field) — not touched to keep this change minimal.

reason: Sim bot fix (forest-rescue 165d49b): rain on first burn -> upgrade-first 100% / cheapest-dps 0%; all suites green; prod smoke PASS

set.title: Pages smoke flow4 false-passes: hidden end overlay ships static 'Game Over' text
set.body:
scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py flow4_battle_resolves() polls text_of('#endTitle') for 'Victory'/'Game Over' as the battle-resolution signal, but index.html ships the hidden overlay with static initial text:

Game Over

and

The jungle was cleared into farmland.

(index.html lines 62-63). The poll therefore matches on its FIRST read, seconds after planting, while the battle is still running — 'full battle resolution' never actually waits for anything. The follow-up 'replay visible' check is equally void: it tests !#replayButton.classList.contains('hidden'), but the button never carries its own hidden class (hiding is via the #endOverlay ancestor), so it always reports True. Evidence (live, 2026-08-31, https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/): script printed "battle resolved -> 'Game Over' (The jungle was cleared into farmland.); replay visible: True" and exited PASS, while its own final screenshot (/tmp/fr-pages-e2e-final-outcome.png, captured immediately after) shows the battle mid-progress — Wave 1 / 3, 4 hearts, no end overlay on screen. The same trap briefly bit this round's new scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_all_levels.py (v2 poll matched the static text instantly on every level, reporting all 7 battles 'resolved' at Wave 1); fixed there by requiring !#endOverlay.classList.contains('hidden') alongside the title text. flow4 needs the same treatment: poll (overlay visible AND title in Victory/Game Over), and derive replay visibility from #endOverlay's visibility. Impact: the smoke's strongest assertion is a no-op; a regression that freezes the engine before the end screen (the class of bug RP-bfjtvp fixed) would still PASS flow4. Repro: python3 scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py (defaults to live site); observe the resolution claim within seconds of planting; open /tmp/fr-pages-e2e-final-outcome.png — no overlay visible.

text: Fixed in parent repo commit abdff77 (scripts/e2e_forest_rescue_pages.py). flow4 now polls (endVisible AND title in Victory/Game Over) — same pattern as e2e_forest_rescue_all_levels.py — and derives replay visibility from #endOverlay's visibility. Local smoke vs http://127.0.0.1:8341/: PASS exit 0; production smoke vs https://chata-games.github.io/forest-rescue/: PASS exit 0. Both resolved with the LIVE message 'The Heartwood was breached.' (not the static 'The jungle was cleared into farmland.' the old poll false-matched) and reported overlay visible: True; replay visible: True; final screenshot shows the real end overlay.

reason: flow4 poll now requires visible #endOverlay with Victory/Game Over title; replay visibility derived from overlay — local and production smoke both PASS exit 0 (parent commit abdff77)
